caption: The drawing features two animals, a hare and a dog, both colored in shades of brown with lighter highlights and darker contour lines. The larger animal, the dog, is depicted in mid-stride, facing to the right with its legs extended as if running. The hare, positioned to the left and slightly ahead of the dog, is shown in a similar running posture, both animals appearing to move in the same direction. The background is a solid, vibrant blue. Throughout the composition, there are branching plants with leaves, rendered in brown and dark colors, spread evenly across the blue background behind the animals. The overall framework is bordered by a wide, pale beige margin.
